gates.name: reference-agreement:partialcor_vs_ppcor
gates.detail: 10/10 agree [partial_spearman_r=0.20087 vs ref 0.20087; neg_log10_p=1.9337 vs ref 1.9337; df=155 vs ref 155; max_diff_ppcor=1.9429e-16 vs ref 0; max_diff_formula=3.3307e-16 vs ref 0; partial_pearson_r=0.04752 vs ref 0.04752; partial_pearson_p=0.55452 vs ref 0.55452; marginal_spearman=0.53168 vs ref 0.53168; attenuated=1 vs ref 1; n=158 vs ref 158]
gates.citation: Partial correlation. Reference impls: ppcor::pcor.test (Kim 2015) and the closed-form residual recompute. Data: eyes-closed-foam COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics), Trail Making Test A time and age, Santos & Duarte (2016) BDS balance dataset.

reference.citation: Partial correlation. Reference impls: ppcor::pcor.test (Kim 2015) and the closed-form residual recompute. Data: eyes-closed-foam COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics), Trail Making Test A time and age, Santos & Duarte (2016) BDS balance dataset.
reference.description: re-computes the Spearman partial correlation of sway and TMT-A controlling for age with ppcor::pcor.test and an independent closed-form formula and confirms partialCorrelation reproduces both to machine precision; also reports the Pearson partial, the marginal Spearman rho, the attenuation and the sample size
